about.text: A soft washed-rind cheese of the Maroilles family, about 300 g, round or heart-shaped. It is curdled with rennet, moulded, washed with salted water and aged 3 to 6 weeks in a cellar, and made on farms in the Somme, Oise, Pas-de-Calais and Nord.

sources.text: The method, the size, the producers by department, from the article.
